title: music.play
description: Start Spotify playback on the active Spotify Connect device. Accepts either a free-text query (resolved via track search; the first match plays) or a spotify uri (spotify:<type>:<id> or an open.spotify.com link — track uris play directly, album/playlist/artist uris play as context). uri wins when both are supplied. The EMPTY form — no query, no uri — RESUMES the device's current context (Spotify's bodyless player/play). The first authenticated call opens the system browser for the PKCE grant; thereafter the cached refresh token authenticates silently. Denies by name: music_no_client_id (SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID unset), music_no_match (query found nothing), music_no_active_device (no active Spotify device — open the Spotify app and play something once), music_bad_uri, music_auth_* (grant denied / timed out / pending).

query.description: Free-text track search, e.g. 'so what miles davis'. First match plays.

uri.description: spotify:<type>:<id> or https://open.spotify.com/<type>/<id>. Takes precedence over query.
